named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Israel's National AI Program (2021–2026, about NIS 1 billion) reviews the global AI landscape and sets five objectives: research and compute infrastructure, high-tech adoption, safe AI in the public sector, geo-technological standing, and ministry preparedness. It favors innovation-friendly, internationally compatible regulation, using sandboxes, a regulatory knowledge center and an expert advisory group.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five objectives: AI infrastructure and research, high-tech adoption, public-sector AI, international standing, ministry preparedness
Multi-year program 2021-2026 with budget of about NIS 1 billion
Regulatory sandboxes in highly regulated, high-potential fields
Establish a cross-government regulatory knowledge center, regulators forum and expert advisory group
Publish an AI ethics and regulation policy principles paper; align with international standards
